summary: Six-phase plan fixing all five verified defects (A-E) in the three task-status scripts and the base implementation agent, ordered E -> C -> D -> B -> A -> integration so each fix lands on a foundation the prior one made safe. Every edit targets the canonical git-tracked agent-system/ tree with a mirrored copy to the gitignored .claude/ deploy tree, and every phase verifies by direct script invocation against an isolated mktemp fixture rather than the status machinery under repair.

artifacts.summary: 6 phases, 4 hours: DEFECT E (partial/blocked termini), DEFECT C (version-ordered plan selection, 3 sites), DEFECT D (scope idempotency early-exit to state.json), DEFECT B (fatal-vs-warn decision table encoded), DEFECT A (wire base agent to update-phase-status.sh), integration verification.
